ownership.quote: Hyperbolic founders Jasper Zhang and Yuchen Jin saw talented people with promising ideas not coming to fruition. Their bottleneck to progress was not a lack of talent or enthusiasm, but compute.

stage.quote: On December 10, Web3 AI cloud startup Hyperbolic announced the completion of a $12 million Series A financing round, led by Variant and Polychain Capital.
stage.note: Last priced equity round is the Dec 2024 $12M Series A. Hyperbolic also has a decentralized/blockchain angle (crypto-native investors), but the round is a standard priced equity Series A, not a token sale.

total_funding_usd.basis: Sum of reported pre-seed ($725K, Nov 2022), seed ($7M, Aug 2024) and Series A ($12M, Dec 2024) per multiple crypto/tech press (Odaily, SuperEX, Binance Square, DefiLlama, The Block) and repeated in an OpenTools piece stating the co-founder 'raised $20 million in funding for the company'; no single primary company statement totaling funding was found.
total_funding_usd.quote: Hyperbolic raised $12 million in a Series A round, bringing total funding to $20 million.

last_round.source: https://www.odaily.news (Financing Express of the Week, 2024-12-16); https://defillama.com (raises)
last_round.quote: On December 10, Web3 AI cloud startup Hyperbolic announced the completion of a $12 million Series A financing round, led by Variant and Polychain Capital.

revenue.basis: Third-party estimate from data aggregator Prospeo, surfaced via Google's AI overview; not confirmed by the company. Company has publicly cited usage/growth metrics (e.g. '195,000+ developers processing 112B+ tokens/month' by mid-2025, and inclusion on Ramp's Top SaaS Vendors list, April 2026) but no disclosed revenue figure.
revenue.quote: industry databases like Prospeo estimate the open-access AI cloud platform's annual revenue to be roughly $3.68 million.

employees.source: https://www.google.com/search?q=Hyperbolic+GPU+cloud+employees+headcount (Built In San Francisco / aggregator estimate via search overview)

note: Hyperbolic (Hyperbolic Labs, Inc., DBA hyperbolic.ai / formerly hyperbolic.xyz) is a GPU compute marketplace/cloud founded 2022 by Jasper Zhang (CEO) and Yuchen Jin (CTO). It has both a conventional AI-cloud product (on-demand/reserved GPU rentals, inference API) and a decentralized/Web3 angle (crypto-native investors such as Polychain Capital, Variant, GSR; plans for a 'proprietary blockchain'), so some sources classify it as a 'Web3 AI' company. Funding facts here are corroborated across several independent press/aggregator sources (Odaily, SuperEX, Binance Square, DefiLlama, The Block via search snippets) but no first-party press release or filing was directly fetched during this research pass, so funding figures are marked 'estimated' rather than 'confirmed'. Not a YC company (no ycombinator.com/companies page found for any hyperbolic-* slug) and no accelerator affiliation was found. Revenue and headcount are third-party estimates only.
